name: 召唤缺失者（Bringing Forth the Missing）

pages.title: 召唤缺失者（Bringing Forth the Missing）
pages.text: 缺失者，又称非玩家，是由缺失纹理构成的奇异致命实体。$(br2)受到挑衅后，它们会攻击玩家，死亡时掉落缺失核心。$(br2)与它们战斗时需要注意，它们能够执行普通玩家的所有操作，因此极为危险。

pages.title: Bringing Forth the Missing
pages.text: The Missing or The Non-Players are strange deadly entities consisting of missing textures. $(br2)They will attack the player when provoked and drop a Missing Core uppon death. $(br2)Know that they can do any action that a normal player can do when fighting them, this makes then incredibly lethal.
